originalBrowserContract.scope: F12 on a Company form edits local display preferences for that target in this browser. Existing saved company UUID and creation view have separate keys. These are not company data or backup flags.
originalBrowserContract.contacts: Hide/show Telephone, independent calling code plus raw Mobile, Fax, Email and Website without clearing, disabling or rewriting their values. Hidden fields are skipped by ordinary visible-field Enter/Shift+Tab navigation.
originalBrowserContract.currency: Expose read-only descriptions of actual Bookr formatting: two decimals, en-IN grouping, prefix symbol without space, current profile/draft symbol/name. No precision, words, suffix, spacing or millions switches.
originalBrowserContract.dialog: Use shared field dialog: Enter next, Ctrl+A apply preferences, Escape/Back cancel with draft/focus restored. F12 never invokes company POST/PUT. Preserve nested Country query and accepted metadata through opening, cancellation and application.
originalBrowserContract.features: F11 and a Company-menu command open grouped Available in Bookr and Unavailable status. Accounts and bill tracking already exist. Inventory, tax, payroll, cost centres, interest, remote access and security are unavailable; no writable flags or fake passwords. More/All change presentation only. Escape/Close works by keyboard.
originalBrowserContract.security: Access control, encryption and edit log remain read-only unavailable until their layer. No input can imply backend protection.
originalBrowserContract.lifecycle: Reuse form controls and saved-profile binding; dispose added listeners and dialogs on leave. Preserve company form draft and current loaded company context. Create still saves/opens normally without a mandatory feature interstitial.
